🚨Breaking: The Cockroach Janitors Party (CJP) has been “blessed by foreign forces,” according to party sources. The satirical youth outfit claims the endorsement gives it divine clearance to sweep India’s exam leaks and job crisis — one antenna at a time. 🪳🧹

Insiders whisper that the mysterious overseas patrons have already dispatched crates of premium imported pesticide-resistant armor and endless supplies of viral hashtags, ensuring every street corner from Jantar Mantar to the remotest coaching center stays permanently “cleaned” of inconvenient truths. 🌍✨

Party strategists insist the foreign blessing also grants exclusive rights to moonlight as both messiahs of the unemployed and official national sanitation consultants, promising that by the next election cycle the entire political establishment will be polished to a mirror shine… or at least thoroughly scrubbed of any remaining credibility. 🧹🗳️
comment: Satire aside, the deeper issue is how public trust gets managed during institutional failures. Real accountability needs transparent processes, not just louder narratives or convenient villains.
